premises.text: Cloud HPC orchestration is too hard compared with electricity-like simplicity
premises.evidence_span: Unfortunately, though, it's not that way today

premises.text: CPUsage auto-distributes a configured sandbox across hundreds or thousands of nodes
premises.evidence_span: We take that instance, and we automatically distribute it and replicate it across hundreds or thousands of compute nodes in the cloud. And then you do the equivalent of simply clicking Start

premises.text: Works for virtually any high-performance or high-throughput application at any scale
premises.evidence_span: distribute virtually any high-performance or high-throughput application across any cloud at any scale

premises.text: Custom API builder for command-line applications
premises.evidence_span: build a custom API specific to your command line application

premises.text: Multi-cloud public then private cloud support roadmap
premises.evidence_span: Today we support Amazon Web Services and over the next few months will add support for other infrastructure such as Microsoft Windows Azure and Google Compute Engine. After that we're going to tackle the private cloud

premises.text: Users should plug in any compute app and consume power without caring about config or source
premises.evidence_span: plug in any compute application, consume as much compute power as you want, without having to think about configuration

value.text: Compute as a utility: plug in and scale without ops complexity
value.evidence_span: vision for compute that looks a lot like electricity

notes: Single domain: roadmap and utility vision treated as part of one platform theory without separate commercial module.
